-- base/main.tf --
resource "aws_cloudwatch_log_group" "this" {
  for_each          = toset(["a", "b"])
  name              = "/aws/rds/cluster/${var.name}/${each.value}"
  retention_in_days = 7
}

variable "name" {
  type = string
}
